name: Tapped Target Defender (Combat)
body:
You earned a perfect score as a warrior in the tapped target tag course at Diamond Academy.

Prerequisite: Diamond Academy Graduate trait, base attack bonus +3.

Benefit: When fighting defensively, you can choose to give the bonus to AC to an adjacent ally instead. You still take the penalty on all attacks.
